reviewer: Codex source adjudication for founder-requested GameStop recovery
adjudication: This scoped addendum identifies English Hisuian Zoroark076/196 with the red GameStop stamp and Holo finish. The unstamped base, Lost Origin-logo stamp and EB Games-logo stamp are separate identities outside this scope. No other finish is inferred. Noble Knight publication-year2026 is not adopted as the card release date.
source_independence: Two evidence families: Bulbapedia editorial release description and exact Face to Face merchant product/image. The merchant page and image are one vote. Noble Knight text included in the combined extraction is not an extra editorial vote.
